questions: Does penalizing quality intercepts induce spurious edge credit?
Does removing question-level nuisance or reweighting observed contrast directions improve decision utility?
How much five-seed credit variation persists across independent seed splits?

variants.R0: historical unique-graph quality ridge, all coefficients penalized
variants.R1: same objective, only global constant coefficient exempt from penalty
variants.R1b: same objective, all nine question-only baseline coefficients exempt
variants.R2: same unique graph rows, center BOTH X and y within training question; penalty unchanged
variants.R3: same underlying unique graph evidence, 24 preplanned contrast directions per question; block-dependent targets

features: unchanged train-only PCA8 plus constant; binary graph terms; phi-major
alpha_selection: old tune80 question-macro mean-credit MSE; tie tolerance1e-12 choose largest; no refit
attribution: also compare each variant at historical fixed alpha; optimized-alpha effects are not isolated penalty effects
primary_development_metric: one-toggle-or-stay mean quality gain vs ZERO_STAY; lambda0; strict-positive max; smallest edge tie
secondary: seed noise and split-seed selected action

uncertainty.scope: exploratory unadjusted intervals, no confirmatory pass

negative_control: fit constant response equal training weighted mean at historical alpha; quality independent of graph

split_seed_diagnostic.rule: choose strictly positive best gain on four seeds else stay; smallest edge on exact tie; evaluate excluded fifth; average five folds

candidate_nomination.selection: tune80 action gain largest, then tune MSE smallest, then order smallest, then variant lexical
candidate_nomination.filter: selected tune gain>0 and exposed120 gain>0, selected point gain exceeds B0 and uniform13
candidate_nomination.fallback_after_evaluation: none; rejected nominee is not replaced by runner-up
candidate_nomination.scope: planning nomination only, not independent evidence

failure_handling: abort on input/hash/support/baseline-replay mismatch; preserve attempt; implementation repairs need versioned event

budget.cpu_time_scope: main process CPU plus child CPU when used; thread CPU included; no child training launched

nonclaims: true zero credit from observed zeros
action_floating_ties: exact equality, consistent with historic D1; no positive tolerance
attribution_limit: linear coefficient/prediction decomposition only; selected-action gains are nonlinear and cannot be causally decomposed
